title: Raichu’s Strangest Response Begins When Its Pouches Run Empty
premise: When Raichu’s electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
audiencePromise: Reveal why Raichu raises its tail when its electric pouches run empty, then show what its tail can do at both extremes.
openLoop: Why would empty electric pouches make Raichu raise its tail?
payoff: Raichu’s tail can discharge excess power or gather electricity from the atmosphere when its pouches run empty.
engagementQuestion: Clever way to gather electricity, or strange tail trick?

voice.instructions: Use a quick, curious pace with crisp emphasis on empty, raises, and atmosphere. Build suspense through the tail’s two different jobs, then pause before the final choice.
